### Provenance of the screenshot observations

The 11 PNG screenshots have no text layer. The committed observations come from **manual transcriptions (`code/multimodal_manual/`) that were checked against the images**. The vision model (VLM) was used as a draft and as a cross-check: each of its results was compared with the manual transcription and every difference was judged by opening the image. No VLM result is frozen, so the pipeline output uses the manual transcriptions. PDFs are read with `pdftotext`, without a model.
